label: Fix three build errors in embedding-provider (FastEmbedPoolConfig, batchSizeHint, MODEL_CONFIGS export)
summary: Fixed three TypeScript build errors in embedding-provider: removed unused FastEmbedPoolConfig import, removed unused batchSizeHint field and dead poolConfig constructor parameter, exported MODEL_CONFIGS from fastembed.ts. All existing changes for BGE-M3/CodeXEmbed models preserved. Build, test, lint all pass.

changes.kind: removed unused batchSizeHint field and dead poolConfig constructor parameter (was only used to seed batchSizeHint)
added MODEL_CONFIGS to named export list
removed poolConfig variable declaration and 4th arg from new FastembedProvider() call

issues: NONE — all three build errors resolved cleanly
handoff_notes: MODEL_CONFIGS is now exported from fastembed.ts — index.ts imports it as `const { FastembedProvider, MODEL_CONFIGS, DEFAULT_MODEL } = await import('./fastembed.js')`
FastEmbedPoolConfig type was removed from fastembed.ts import (constructor no longer accepts poolConfig). The type is still exported from index.ts for consumers that need it.
The batchSizeHint field was removed entirely — embedBatch batch size is set via the opts parameter at call time only.
Verify that no caller passes poolConfig to new FastembedProvider(model, dim, cacheDir) — constructor signature is now 3-arg.
